title: The Drowned Salt Again
author: P. M. Iversen
blurb: Quentin Kavanagh, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
